_meta.partTwoRuling: Reviewer package Part 2 ruled 10/10 on 2026-08-03. 8 routed out as narrative statements (31:115, 40:134, 40:135, 113:231, 129:249, 129:251, 129:252, 130:254); 2 kept as supplications (15:26, 31:114). Two of the eight carry an embedded recitable phrase the owner noted but did NOT keep as a corpus dua under that record — 40:134 and 130:254 — so neither is later reinstated on the grounds that a dua is visible in the text. The ruling is about what the RECORD is.

quran:2:200.reason: Already flagged `contextual` in the corpus: the Qur'an quotes this as the request of those who ask only for this world. 2:201 is the praised form.

quran:6:128.reason: Speech of jinn and men on the Day of Judgement.

quran:7:38.reason: The damned in the Fire asking for their misleaders to be doubly punished.

quran:14:44.reason: The wrongdoers on the Day of Judgement asking to be sent back.

quran:15:36.reason: Speech of Iblis, asking to be reprieved until the Day of Resurrection.

quran:15:39.reason: Speech of Iblis, vowing to make disobedience attractive to mankind.

quran:16:86.reason: The polytheists pointing to their idols on the Day of Judgement.

quran:20:125.reason: The one raised blind on the Day of Judgement, asking why.

quran:20:134.reason: The damned asking why no messenger was sent to them.

quran:23:106.reason: The damned admitting their wretchedness in the Fire.

quran:23:107.reason: The damned asking to be removed from the Fire.

quran:28:47.reason: The damned asking why no messenger was sent.

quran:28:63.reason: Those who misled others disowning them on the Day of Judgement.

quran:32:12.reason: The criminals asking to be returned to the world.

quran:33:68.reason: The damned asking that their leaders be doubly punished.

quran:34:19.reason: Already flagged `contextual`: the people of Saba asking for hardship in their travels, and punished for it.

quran:35:37.reason: The damned asking to be removed so they may do righteousness.

quran:38:16.reason: The mockers asking for their share of punishment to be hastened.

quran:38:61.reason: The damned asking for double punishment on whoever brought it upon them.

quran:40:11.reason: The damned confessing their sins and asking for a way out.

quran:41:29.reason: The damned asking to see those who misled them.

quran:50:27.reason: Satan's companion disowning him on the Day of Judgement.

quran:63:10.reason: The one who neglected charity, asking at death to be delayed.

ibnmajah:3590.reason: The hadith teaches the OPPOSITE — "O Allah, forgive me if You will" is quoted as the wording one must NOT use; the narration continues "Let him be definite in his asking". Publishing this as a dua would invert the hadith. Same class as Qur'an 2:200.
